_comment: Example Compliance Guard Configuration showing illustrative categoryPaths and decisions. Copy relevant sections into config.json and adapt for your project. The ruleFile paths below are project-relative — point them at rules you maintain in your own ./rules/ directory; the plugin only ships fusion-workbench-conventions.md and leaves domain rules to the consuming project.

decisions.statement: Structural ontology changes (add/remove/consolidate top-level entities, relations, or schema definitions) require review with a domain owner before merge
Read/viewer code may not perform logical transformations on ontology data — no beautification, normalization, or semantic interpretation in the read path
When changing ontology or its viewer, verify existing functionality is preserved before merging
Dependencies flow one direction; no cycles. Layers talk only to immediate neighbors.
Don't bypass an abstraction because it's inconvenient. If wrong, fix or replace it.

churn._comment: Per-session change counts only. There is deliberately no lifetime threshold: totalChanges is monotonic for the life of a project, so comparing it against one made every write report a critical for ever once any file crossed it (decision 260809-2004).
